name: scenario_MoonCloud_consent_is_off_until_asked
description: Nothing leaves the device until someone says so. Both MoonCloud children carry their own consent, because wanting a joint light show is not agreeing to usage reporting, and each is proven off by default and durable once set.

steps.name: stats-consent-is-off
steps.description: A fresh device reports nothing. This is the assertion that matters most on this card.

steps.name: talk-consent-is-off
steps.description: And the same for Talk, which is a separate decision rather than the same one.

steps.name: opt-in
steps.description: Someone switches it on, which is the only way it ever becomes true.

steps.name: restart
steps.description: Restart: a consent that quietly reverts would report without asking twice.

steps.name: opt-out-again
steps.description: And off again, because withdrawing has to work as well as granting.
